bounds.domain: One already admitted reverse lookup. Two preference values, two initial cancellation values, four nearby outcomes and four geocode outcomes form 64 input configurations. Each upstream is invoked at most once.
bounds.limitations: The actual provider is exercised through loopback HTTP for all 64 configurations. Google availability, in-flight cancellation timing, route admission, organization quotas, mobile panel lifetime and concurrent requests are outside this projection. Existing owners retain those responsibilities.

assumptions: Weak fairness of advance assumes each admitted upstream request settles with success, empty data, an invalid response or an outage. It does not assume provider success.
